title: New Method Pulls Faint Planets Out of Webb Images
paragraphs: A new computer method helps find planets. It works with pictures from the Webb space telescope. Bright stars hide small planets in the pictures.
The method makes a copy of the camera on the computer. Then it finds the light of the star and removes it. The planets are easier to see.
In tests, it found planets two to 15 times better than old methods. Scientists wrote about it in the journal Nature.
